Section 2 — Project Concept & Idea
What is your project called? (working title is fine)
HoopIQ — NBA Stats & AI Game Analysis Dashboard
Describe your project in 2–3 sentences.
What does it do? Who is it for? What problem does it solve?

HoopIQ is a full-stack PHP web application that displays live and historical NBA player and team statistics pulled from a public sports API. It is designed for basketball fans and sports enthusiasts who want a quick, clean way to explore NBA data. The app solves the problem of scattered stats across multiple websites by centralizing player search, team standings, and AI-generated game breakdowns in one dashboard.
What is the ONE core feature your app will demonstrate?
Example: 'A chatbot that answers FAQs using an AI API' or 'A live inventory tracker with low-stock alerts'

A real-time NBA player and team stats search powered by a public sports API (BallDontLie or NBA API), combined with an AI analysis feature where users can ask questions like “How has LeBron James been performing this season?” and receive a natural-language breakdown generated by the Claude API.
